caption: The drawing depicts a wooden table with an oval-shaped top composed of several planks. The table is a natural brown color, showcasing the wood grain detail throughout its surface and legs. It has four turned, ornamental legs connected by H- and X-shaped stretchers made of similarly turned wood, also brown in color. There is a single drawer in the center of the table, set just below the tabletop, with a small round pull handle. The drawing is on a plain, light-colored background with no additional objects or patterns, keeping the focus solely on the table.
title: Gateleg Table
